title: OntoRAG entity index record
description: One line of ontology/entities.jsonl. A flattened projection of the RDF graph for fast loading and for chunk↔entity linking, without requiring a SPARQL engine. The graph (ontology/world.ttl) remains the source of truth.

aliases.description: Alternative surface forms used to detect mentions of this entity in chunk text.

attestedIn.description: Book slugs whose prose mentions this entity (derived from chunk↔entity links). The entity's footprint across the corpus; enables reconstructing 'the world as known from book subset S'. Empty if no ingested book mentions it.

definedIn.description: Book slug(s) this entity was extracted/defined from (from the extraction shard's `evidence` chunks). The entity's origin, distinct from mere mention; empty for hand-curated spine entities.
